flashcard_import.prompt_one:
Create one study flashcard based on the topic or notes I give you. Return only a valid JSON object with version: 1 and a cards array with one item. Omit deck so I can choose one in Nodia. question and answer are required strings of up to {{textLimit}} characters each. Include source as optional text of up to {{sourceLimit}} characters when you know the source. Follow this example structure:

{{example}}
flashcard_import.prompt_deck:
Create a study flashcard deck based on the topic or notes I give you. Return only a valid JSON object with version: 1, deck with a title of up to {{titleLimit}} characters and an optional category of up to {{categoryLimit}} characters, and a cards array of 1 to {{limit}} flashcards. Do not name the deck General. Each card needs question and answer as strings of up to {{textLimit}} characters each and may include source as text of up to {{sourceLimit}} characters when you know the source. Follow this example structure:

{{example}}

example.title: English for travel
example.question: How can you ask for the time in English?
example.second_question: How can you ask for directions to the train station?
example.second_answer: How do I get to the train station?

form_intro: Give your plan a title and tell us what you want to learn. Optional fields help tailor the proposal; use the help icons for examples.

form_help.topic: Name the main subject without describing the whole course. Example: networking and DNS. Maximum 240 characters.
form_help.objective: Describe what you want to understand or be able to do by the end of the plan. Example: understand how DNS works and learn to diagnose why a domain does not resolve. Maximum 2000 characters.
form_help.title: Optional: a short name to recognize your plan. Example: DNS for my job. Maximum 120 characters.
form_help.declared_base: In your own words, describe what you know about the topic, what you have practiced and what you still find difficult. You can say you are starting from scratch; no proof of knowledge is needed here. Example: I know what an IP address is, but I do not understand DNS records. Optional, maximum 4000 characters.
form_help.context: Describe the project, environment or situation behind your study and any conditions Teacher should consider. Example: I work with an API on Ubuntu and need to understand how to connect its domain. Avoid passwords or private data. Optional, maximum 4000 characters.
form_help.explanation_language: Choose the language for the plan explanations. Example: English to practice technical vocabulary. This preference does not change menu language or guarantee provider quality.
form_help.organization: Let Teacher suggest a structure, or choose days or topics. Example: days to spread out study, or topics to progress through concepts.
form_help.day_count: When organizing by days, choose between 1 and 365. Example: 10 study days to spread out learning. These are not calendar dates or a guaranteed duration; review the proposal before accepting it.

form_hints.declared_base: Describe what you already know and find difficult, or say you are starting from scratch.
form_hints.context: Describe your starting situation or project and how you want to apply what you learn.
